titulo: Three small notes on three green pots
caption:
Three small notes on three green pots

Three green pots look the same on a table. Three small notes and nobody has to guess what needs what.

A label takes ten seconds, and it keeps you from knowing 'the leafy one' for a year.

For whoever writes the name on each pot.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A table with three leafy plants in an orange, a blue and a yellow pot. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks in from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans, and a small note appears on each pot, reading mint, basil and dill. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me naming each pot.
